text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every Umamusume carries the hopes of their fans with her, and Matikanetannhauser is no exception.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When asked who he's cheering for before the Takarazuka Kinen, the bespectacled reporter answers, "Matikanetannhauser" without missing a beat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, in the paddock, Mejiro McQueen tells Matikanetannhauser she's noticed a massive improvement in her and challenges her directly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So many unique competitors have gathered at the Takarazuka Kinen! We need to stay focused and aim for victory!
